name: Eucharist
overview: The Scripture passage in Matthew 26:17-22 presents the institution of the Eucharist during the Passover meal, where Jesus instructs His disciples to prepare for this significant event. As they gather together, Jesus reveals the impending betrayal by one of them, highlighting the solemn and prophetic nature of this meal. This moment marks a pivotal point in Jesus' ministry, emphasizing both fellowship and the foretelling of His sacrifice.
